Name: Maachah, Concubine of Caleb
Summary: Concubine of Caleb who bore Sheber, Tirhanah, and Shaaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:48: Concubine of Caleb who bore Sheber, Tirhanah, and Shaaph.
LifeLesson: The mention of Maachah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
